data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Script runs evaluator 3× per fixture at temp=0, asserts per-fixture variance ≤ 0.5

## Implementation Notes
Current state: visual-eval-calibration.sh reads pre-existing label files; does NOT invoke evaluator.

Fix: Add an `--evaluate` flag to visual-eval-calibration.sh that:
1. For each fixture in --corpus-dir, invokes the labeling pipeline 3 times at temperature=0 (run_1, run_2, run_3)
2. Writes labels/llm_agent_run_1.json, _run_2.json, _run_3.json with provenance:llm_agent
3. After labeling, runs the gate checks

Extend label_visual_corpus.py:
- label_all(corpus_dir, runs=3, temperature=0.0) — accepts a runs parameter (was hardcoded to 2)
- Variance computation in visual_eval_gates.compute_variance_per_fixture must use score data from 3 runs (per-dimension score variance across the 3 runs); if labels only have attribution_class (current stub), compute attribution_class disagreement rate as proxy and document the limitation

Update tests:
- _make_fixture helper: accept runs parameter to create 3 runs
- test_variance_gate_pass and test_variance_gate_fail: rewrite to use 3 runs

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] label_all accepts runs parameter (default 3)
  Verify: grep -E 'def label_all.*runs' plugins/dso/scripts/label_visual_corpus.py
- [ ] visual-eval-calibration.sh has --evaluate flag invoking 3-run labeling
  Verify: grep -q 'evaluate' plugins/dso/scripts/visual-eval-calibration.sh
- [ ] Tests use 3-run fixtures for variance assertions
  Verify: grep -q 'llm_agent_run_3' tests/visual_eval/test_visual_eval_gates.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
data.title: Remediation: Add 3-run evaluator invocation loop to visual-eval-calibration.sh (dd-1)
